LanguageData.LP_BG_HolyTime.stages.0.label: sacred time
LanguageData.LP_BG_HolyTime.stages.0.description: Just attended a ritual. The familiar prayers and incense remind me of my days in the temple.
LanguageData.LP_BG_HeroPresent.stages.0.label: the hero is here
LanguageData.LP_BG_HeroPresent.stages.0.description: That folk hero is standing right beside me with a weapon. With a hero here, we'll make it through.
LanguageData.LP_BG_HeroFallen.stages.0.label: the hero has fallen
LanguageData.LP_BG_HeroFallen.stages.0.description: Even that folk hero has fallen... do we really still have hope?
LanguageData.LP_BG_NobleBedroom.stages.0.label: beneath my station
LanguageData.LP_BG_NobleBedroom.stages.0.description: This place dares call itself a bedroom? The stables at my family home were more dignified.
LanguageData.LP_BG_SageNoStudy.stages.0.label: nothing to read
LanguageData.LP_BG_SageNoStudy.stages.0.description: There isn't even a bookshelf or research bench here. Days without learning drag on like years.
LanguageData.LP_BG_HermitRoom.stages.0.label: a place of solitude
LanguageData.LP_BG_HermitRoom.stages.0.description: I have a room all to myself. Close the door and the world goes quiet.
LanguageData.LP_BG_HermitRoom.stages.1.label: no peace and quiet
LanguageData.LP_BG_HermitRoom.stages.1.description: There's someone else breathing in the room when I sleep. I miss being alone in the wilds.
LanguageData.LP_BG_OutlanderCooped.stages.0.label: cooped up
LanguageData.LP_BG_OutlanderCooped.stages.0.descripti: Haven't seen the sky for three whole days. I need wind, I need rain, I need to get out.
